title: 第3章 价值一千八的发型第4章 幸运女神在微笑
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：财富自由从毕业开始第3章价值一千八的发型（..）作为知名的国际甲级商厦，恒隆广场隶属于香江恒隆地产旗下，明城的恒隆广场是几年前才建起来的，入驻的大多是奢侈品牌，绝对算得上系统口中的核心商圈了。
站在广场前的阶梯上，周望掏出手机开始搜索附近的理发店。
其实周望本来想在车上先找好的，可问题是他一玩手机就晕车……
在手机上看了一会，周望陷入了预期之中的纠结。
既然是核心商圈，附近自然是不乏理发店的，可正是因为选择太多了，所以才让人眼花缭乱。
旗舰店、高端造型、私人定制、男士理发……各种英文夹杂着日语，每家看起来都很高大上，让周望选择困难。
当然，更重要的是那句名言：
『没有人能笑着从理发店走出来』
如果是平常也就算了，但今天的周望是带着任务来的，系统的报销比例直接取决于发型的好看程度，这就不得不慎重了啊！
周望仔细想了一下，既然选不出来，那干脆直接找一家最贵的。
虽然最贵的未必是最好的，但在一个竞争激烈的服务行业，价格至少能决定下限。
重新以价格排序，周望很快锁定了一家名为“TIME”
的发型工作室。
不为别的，就点评APP上那个人均897的价格就足以吸引眼球。
虽然这个价格大概率是被烫染拉了上去，但一般的理发店人均也就50到100多，刚才周望看到最贵的也只是299人罢了。
看了下地址，这家工作室就在恒隆广场6楼，周望先打了一個电话预约，得到肯定的答复以后，这才进入商场，顺着直梯来到了6楼。
在一个相对僻静的转角，周望找到了这家店。
米白色的门墙，没有太多的花里胡哨，只在右侧的墙上有一个艺术字体的木质logo，写着“Time·发型工作室”
的字样。
进入门廊，明亮但不刺眼的灯光映照下，右侧站着一男一女两个身穿工装的迎宾助理，看到周望进来，右侧长相甜美、扎着马尾的小姐姐笑着走了过来。

“您好，请问有预约吗？”
“刚打过电话。”
“好的，请跟我来。”
确认过后，小姐姐引着周望走进了店里，在一处有透明玻璃隔断的会客区域坐了下来。
周望环顾了一下店里的环境，整体装修确实很有设计感，运用了大量的几何元素，兼顾了简约和时尚。
不知是因为时间比较早，还是因为这家店做了很多隔断空间的缘故，周望并没有在店里看到其他客人。
而最吸引周望的目光，是背面墙上挂着的十来个相框。
相框之中装裱的人物都是俊男靓女，而且周望居然认识大半，只因这些人全都是明星，有好几个还是现在依旧活跃于一线的当红花旦。
“这是……”
“这些明星全都是我们店的创始人张俊峰老师服务过的对象哦。”
小姐姐笑着介绍道。
周望眼睛一亮，虽然他知道这些东西也只是一种噱头，但确实又让他对这家店的信心提升了不少。
“那能请这位张老师帮我剪吗？”
周望直接问道。
“周先生，不好意思，张老师今天刚好不在店里，而且找他的话您可能要提前一天预约才行哦！”
“这样啊，那你帮我推荐一位发型师算了。”
周望闻言虽然有些失望，但他显然不可能再等一天，于是说道。
“好的，如果周先生您要求比较高的话，我为您推荐店里的岳飞老师，他是张俊峰老师的首徒，也是目前工作室里的首席设计师，理发的基础费用是1799元……”
小姐姐点亮了桌面上的pad，翻到了一页人物图册，替周望介绍着。
“多少？”

周望一呆，忍不住打断了对方。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Wealth Freedom Begins from Graduation Chapter 3 A Hairstyle Worth 1,800 (..) As a well-known international Grade A commercial building, Plaza 66 is affiliated to Xiangjiang Hang Lung Properties. Plaza 66 in Mingcheng was only built a few years ago. Most of the residents are luxury brands. It is definitely considered a core business district in the system.
Standing on the steps in front of the square, Zhou Wang took out his mobile phone and started searching for nearby barber shops.
In fact, Zhou Wang originally wanted to find someone in the car first, but the problem was that he got motion sick whenever he played with his mobile phone...
After watching it on his phone for a while, Zhou Wang fell into the expected tangle.
Since it is a core business district, there is no shortage of barber shops nearby, but it is precisely because there are so many choices that it can be confusing.
Flagship store, high-end styling, private customization, men's haircuts... all in English mixed with Japanese, each one looks very high-end, making it difficult for Zhou Wang to choose.
Of course, the more important thing is the famous saying:
"No one can walk out of the barber shop smiling"
If it was normal, forget it, but today's Zhou Wang came with a mission, and the system's reimbursement ratio directly depends on the beauty of the hairstyle, so you have to be cautious!
Zhou Wang thought about it carefully, and since he couldn't choose, he might as well just find the most expensive one.
Although the most expensive may not necessarily be the best, in a highly competitive service industry, price can at least determine the lower limit.
After re-sorting by price, Zhou Wang quickly locked on a company called "TIME"
hairstyling studio.
If nothing else, the per capita price of 897 on the Dianping APP is enough to attract attention.
Although the price is likely to be driven up by perm and dyeing, the average barber shop only costs 50 to 100 per person. The most expensive one I saw just now was only 299 people.
After looking at the address, the studio was on the 6th floor of Plaza 66. Zhou Wang made a phone call to make an appointment. After getting a positive reply, he entered the mall and followed the elevator to the 6th floor.
In a relatively secluded corner, Zhou Wang found this store.
The off-white door wall does not have too many bells and whistles. There is only a wooden logo with artistic fonts on the right wall that reads "Time Hair Studio"
of words.
Entering the porch, illuminated by bright but not dazzling lights, two reception assistants in work clothes, a man and a woman, stood on the right side. Seeing Zhou Wang enter, a sweet-looking young lady with a ponytail on the right walked over with a smile.
"Hello, do you have an appointment?"
"Just called."
"Okay, please follow me."
After confirming, the young lady led Zhou Wang into the store and sat down in a reception area with a transparent glass partition.
Zhou Wang looked around the environment of the store. The overall decoration was indeed very designed, using a lot of geometric elements, taking into account simplicity and fashion.
I don't know whether it was because it was earlier or because the store had a lot of partitions, but Zhou Wang didn't see other customers in the store.
What attracts Zhou Wang's attention the most are the dozen or so picture frames hanging on the wall behind.
The people framed in the photo frames were all handsome men and beautiful women, and Zhou Wang actually knew most of them because they were all celebrities, and several of them were still popular actresses who were still active on the front line.
"This is..."
"These celebrities are all served by the founder of our store, Mr. Zhang Junfeng."
The young lady introduced with a smile.
Zhou Wang's eyes lit up. Although he knew that these things were just a gimmick, it did increase his confidence in this store.
"Can I ask Teacher Zhang to help me cut it?"
Zhou Wang asked directly.
"Mr. Zhou, I'm sorry, Teacher Zhang is not in the store today, and if you want to see him, you may have to make an appointment one day in advance!"
"That's it, then you can recommend a hairstylist for me."
Although Zhou Wang was a little disappointed when he heard this,But he obviously couldn't wait another day, so he said.
"Okay, Mr. Zhou, if your requirements are higher, I would recommend Teacher Yue Fei in the shop. He is Teacher Zhang Junfeng's first disciple and the current chief designer of the studio. The basic cost of a haircut is 1,799 yuan..."
The young lady lit up the pad on the desktop, turned to a page of character albums, and introduced Zhou Wang.
"How much?"
Zhou Wang was stunned and couldn't help but interrupt the other party.
